snippet.title: Adding NEW Biomes & Enemies to my Roguelike | Chemical Combat Devlog 4
snippet.description:
Hi everyone, it's time for a fourth devlog on Chemical Combat. I'll showcase the new floors, enemies, systems and menus that I've been creating in preparation for release, which will be on the 12th September. 🧪

🎮 Come wishlist Chemical Combat on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3490250/Chemical_Combat/


💬 Join my discord server here!
https://discord.com/invite/NxDSW65sUY

🙋‍♂️ Support the channel by subscribing!
https://www.youtube.com/@sigmoiddev

🎬 Check out the rest of the devlogs!
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdCLXFnLGVkDi819PJWZBBoNhcDzZCGev


📖 Chapters:
0:00 - Intro
0:59 - Floors
1:33 - Enemies
2:46 - Death Screen
3:17 - Main Menu
3:53 - Music & SFX
4:16 - Mining System
4:55 - Preparations
5:40 - Outro & Plans


🎶 Music:
massobeats - city | https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OYEOgbl9VHo https://freetouse.com/music/massobeats/city
massobeats - glimmer | https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kETJF0dijxM https://freetouse.com/music/massobeats/glimmer
massobeats - mango tea | https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Rxae3UZv_zI https://freetouse.com/music/massobeats/mango-tea
 

🔗 Credits:
All Icons by Freepik on FlatIcon https://www.flaticon.com/
All Gifs from https://tenor.com/


📱Software:
Recording: OBS Studio 🎥
Editing: DaVinci Resolve🎬
Engine: Unity 🕹️
IDE: Visual Studio Code 💻
Theme: Rainglow - Rainbow 🌈
Pixel Art: Aseprite 🖼️
Planning: Obsidian🗒️
Production: BandLab 🎹
